title: [T1-c reader] Expose riskAssessment and run linkage through the strict PolicyEvaluationAuthority reader and fill the RISK_TIER slot in readApprovalRecordFacts so approval.decide_intent can mint
description:
Third of the T1 chain (ruling comment-c86c35cb on task-ba102165, condition 2: "PolicyEvaluationAuthority exposes riskAssessment through the strict reader; the seam's APPROVAL_INTENT_RISK_TIER_UNAVAILABLE refusal flips only when a computed tier for THIS run exists"). UNPARK: [T1-b producer] DONE on disk AND task-ba102165 DONE (readApprovalRecordFacts present: `git grep -n 'export function readApprovalRecordFacts' HEAD -- apps/daemon/src/planning/` EXIT 0).

THE GAP, MEASURED AT HEAD 5b3d7313: `PolicyEvaluationAuthority` (apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/bootstrap-policy-authority-reader.ts:35-48) exposes {action, decision, decisionDigest, decisionDigestVersion, graphNodeRevisionRefs, ok, policyRef, principalId, projectId, scope, sliceRef} — it replays the record but DROPS riskAssessment (comment-218ba48d on ba102165) and has no run linkage. approval-intent.ts:194 refuses APPROVAL_MISSING_FACT_CODES[0] = APPROVAL_INTENT_RISK_TIER_UNAVAILABLE first; after ba102165 the seam consults `readApprovalRecordFacts` which names the first missing fact.

DELIVER: (1) the strict reader returns `riskAssessment` (computedTier/effectiveTier/usedFactIds/callerRiskHint, replay-verified like every other field) and `runId`, and a run-scoped selector `readRunPolicyEvaluation(store, {projectId, runId})` that answers the ONE PolicyEvaluated the producer wrote for THIS run (never the newest project-wide row; ambiguity refuses); (2) readApprovalRecordFacts derives `riskTier` = that assessment's computedTier for the run, absent -> `missing: APPROVAL_INTENT_RISK_TIER_UNAVAILABLE` with the reader's code+layer as upstream; (3) with riskTier + applicablePolicyRef (ba102165) + stepUpAuthRef (3b61860f) + budgetRef (61a2e8ad chain) all present the seam composes and MINTS the ApprovalDecisionRecord through core's validateApprovalRecord — this row proves the tier slot and the ordering, and mints only if the other three have landed (otherwise it proves the refusal advanced past RISK_TIER to the next missing fact).
definitionOfDone: VERIFY-OR-BLOCK first, in a row comment with `git rev-parse HEAD` quoted, greps unpiped with exit codes plus a positive control: [T1-b] DONE and PolicyEvaluated records carry runId + riskAssessment at HEAD; task-ba102165 DONE and readApprovalRecordFacts present; the strict reader still drops riskAssessment (`git grep -n 'riskAssessment' HEAD -- apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/bootstrap-policy-authority-reader.ts` EXIT 1 — EXIT 0 = adopt/verify/report duplicate); every exact-shape pin of PolicyEvaluationAuthority enumerated (policy-admission-reader.ts:70-77 consumer, fixtures, tests) and owned.

The strict reader returns replay-verified `riskAssessment` and `runId`; `readRunPolicyEvaluation(store, {projectId, runId})` answers exactly the producer's row for that run (a second row for another run is never selected — arm), refuses with exact code+layer when absent/ambiguous/unverified; policy-admission-reader.ts's existing consumer compiles and its suites pass unedited.

readApprovalRecordFacts derives `riskTier` from the run's computedTier through the production reader (absence -> missing APPROVAL_INTENT_RISK_TIER_UNAVAILABLE @ DAEMON_APPROVAL_INTENT with upstream) and never from a payload, a default, or the newest project-wide evaluation; an arm drives approval.decide_intent through the production command for a finalized classified run and asserts the seam's refusal ADVANCES past RISK_TIER to the next missing fact (or MINTS the record through validateApprovalRecord when all four facts exist at the delivered tree — state which, with the count of durable ApprovalDecisionRecord events).

Mutation drills with SHA256 restore proofs: select the newest project-wide row instead of the run's -> the run-linkage arm reds; return an unverified row's assessment -> the strict arm reds; default riskTier when absent -> the absence arm reds. Gates standalone/unpiped with counts: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck`, the authority-reader/admission/approval-intent/approval-record-facts suites from apps/daemon, `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` path-attributed; every production source <= 250 lines; explicit-pathspec commit; completion comment names the seam family rows and states: 'a finalized run's policy-declared tier now reaches approval.decide_intent; the seam refuses only on facts not yet produced'.
taskRails: Run-scoped selection only; never the newest project-wide PolicyEvaluated; ambiguity and unverified rows refuse with exact code+layer.
Compose the strict reader (replay-verified) and readApprovalRecordFacts; never a second reader of PolicyEvaluated bytes; never a default tier.
Sequenced after [T1-b] and task-ba102165; the mint arm is honest about which facts exist at the delivered tree.
Explicit-pathspec commits; foreign WIP preserved; <=250 lines per production source; TDD red-first through the production command.

implementationPlan.description: VERIFY-OR-BLOCK (DoD-1) — read-only, ONE moe.add_comment, `git rev-parse HEAD` quoted, greps UNPIPED with exit codes + a positive control. (a) T1-b landed: PolicyEvaluated rows carry runId + riskAssessment — `git grep -n 'riskAssessment' HEAD -- apps/daemon/src/planning/run-policy-evaluation.ts apps/daemon/src/planning/planning-authority-finalize.ts` EXIT 0; quote task-a888038d's completionSummary from epicSiblings for the payload key roster instead of re-deriving it. (b) task-ba102165 DONE and `readApprovalRecordFacts` present; task-3b61860f and task-be80cb74 DONE — quote the walk export (`git grep -n 'firstMissingApprovalFact' HEAD -- apps/daemon/src/planning/approval-record-facts.ts` EXIT 0) and the slots present (riskTier?/stepUpAuthRef?/budgetRef?). (c) THE GAP IS OPEN: `git grep -n 'riskAssessment' HEAD -- apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/bootstrap-policy-authority-reader.ts` EXIT 1 (EXIT 0 = adopt/verify/report duplicate). (d) CONSUMER PIN ENUMERATION: readPolicyEvaluationAuthority's callers — measured at plan time: activation/policy-admission-reader.ts:70 (value) and activation/admission-gate-resolver.ts:42,:103 (types); re-grep and list every hit plus every exact-shape fixture/test pinning PolicyEvaluationAuthority's key set. (e) porcelain on owned paths; foreign dirt noted, never staged.

RED FIRST — STRICT READER WIDENING (DoD-2 first half). Arms in the reader's existing suite: (i) a RUN-SCOPED PolicyEvaluated row (T1-b shape) reads back with `riskAssessment` (computedTier et al) and `runId`, REPLAY-VERIFIED like every existing field — the assessment must be consistent with the replayed decision material, not merely present (mirror the :176-215 replay/digest discipline); a row whose riskAssessment disagrees with its replayed material refuses with the reader's existing mismatch vocabulary (exact code asserted); (ii) a LEGACY caller-driven row (no runId) still reads EXACTLY as today — same fields, same refusals (both-shapes arm); (iii) the existing consumer compiles and passes unedited: policy-admission-reader.ts and admission-gate-resolver.ts untouched (`git diff --stat` EMPTY on both; their suites green — quote counts). THEN GREEN in bootstrap-policy-authority-reader.ts: widen PolicyEvaluationAuthority with OPTIONAL `riskAssessment?` and `runId?` (optional so legacy rows and the existing consumer are untouched), verify them on run-scoped rows inside the existing exact-check block. The file is AT 220 LINES — the edit is surgical; if it crosses 250, move existing lines OUT into a sibling (fix-by-subtraction), never past the cap.

RED FIRST — THE RUN-SCOPED SELECTOR (DoD-2 second half). NEW `apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/run-policy-selection.ts` + one-line exact-LF bridge + `run-policy-selection.test.ts`. Export `readRunPolicyEvaluation(store, { projectId, runId })`: walks the run linkage (the runId the T1-b writer persisted — selection by RUN, never by recency), hands the selected row to the STRICT reader (composition — never a second byte-reader), and answers `{ ok: true, evaluation }` with the replay-verified assessment. THREE refusals, each its own arm asserting code AND layer (module-local literals, no *_LAYER column-zero export): ABSENT (no row for the run), AMBIGUOUS (two rows claim the run — seed two and assert the refusal names ambiguity, never picks either), UNVERIFIED (the strict reader refused — its code+layer carried verbatim as upstream, never restamped). RUN-LINKAGE ARM (DoD-2's 'a second row for another run is never selected'): seed evaluations for run A and run B, ask for A, assert the returned assessment is A's BY VALUE (distinct tiers in the fixture so a wrong pick cannot alias). Module <= 250 lines.

RED FIRST — THE RISK_TIER SLOT (DoD-3). Arms in approval-record-facts.test.ts: (i) with a finalized classified run seeded through PRODUCTION T1-b finalize, `readApprovalRecordFacts` derives `derived.riskTier` = the run's computedTier THROUGH `readRunPolicyEvaluation` (production both sides); (ii) absence (no evaluation for the run) -> missing APPROVAL_INTENT_RISK_TIER_UNAVAILABLE @ DAEMON_APPROVAL_INTENT with the selector's refusal as `upstream` (code+layer verbatim); (iii) NEVER-NEWEST: seed a NEWER project-wide evaluation for a DIFFERENT run and assert the requested run's tier is still returned — the recency trap arm. THEN GREEN in approval-record-facts.ts: deriveFacts composes readRunPolicyEvaluation; the walk map marks RISK_TIER established when derived.riskTier is present; ABSENCE IS NOT A VALUE (field absent on refusal, never defaulted). Re-measure the file's line count AFTER the two sibling rows' edits; if past 250, split per the standing subtraction rule. THE SEAM ARM (DoD-3 tail, in approval-intent.test.ts): drive approval.decide_intent through the production command for the finalized classified run with the composition-root witness present — assert the refusal ADVANCES past RISK_TIER: if stepUp+budget+policyRef are all establishable at the delivered tree, the seam MINTS through validateApprovalRecord (count durable ApprovalDecisionRecord events = 1 and state it); otherwise assert the EXACT next missing code in roster order and record which facts existed. HONESTY over ambition: state which branch ran in the completion comment.

MUTATION DRILLS (DoD-4), one degree of freedom, %TEMP%\f42d5165-<workerId>\ backups; SHA256 restore proofs for the UNTRACKED new module trio in a SEPARATE call from the restore; `git diff --exit-code` only for tracked paths. (D1) in run-policy-selection.ts, select the NEWEST project-wide row instead of the run's -> the run-linkage arm AND the recency-trap arm red (distinct tiers make the alias visible). (D2) return an unverified row's assessment (skip the strict-reader handoff) -> the UNVERIFIED arm reds and the replay-consistency arm of step 2 reds. (D3) in approval-record-facts.ts, default riskTier (e.g. "R0") when the selector refuses -> the absence arm (ii) reds. (D4) drop the ambiguity check (pick the first of two claimant rows) -> the AMBIGUOUS arm reds. A GREEN drill is a FINDING — report, never bank. Record D1-D4 with red lines and restore proofs in ONE row comment.
